summary: AstraZeneca PLC furnished a routine Form 6-K disclosing that its Alexion rare-disease unit's drug Klygefa (gefurulimab) received a positive CHMP opinion recommending EU approval as add-on therapy for anti-AChR antibody-positive generalised myasthenia gravis in adults. The opinion rests on the PREVAIL Phase III trial, which met its primary MG-ADL endpoint at week 26 (treatment difference -1.6, p<0.0001), with benefit from week one. No deal, price, stake, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are involved; this is an ordinary regulatory milestone, not a special situation.
